reason: A Windows desktop shell and plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness, providing native windowing, tray and notification integration, configurable skins, panels, file and Git browsing, terminal access, and desktop-oriented conversation features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 原生桌面外壳及插件套件，包含托盘与通知、桌面设置、主题中心、文件和 Git 面板以及终端功能。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop shell and plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness with tray and notification support, desktop settings, skin selection, file and Git panels, and terminal access.

capabilities: Runs as a native Windows WebView2 desktop application
Starts and manages a local DeepSeek Harness backend process
Sends Windows toast notifications and handles interactive replies
Reads files and displays text, images, videos, PDFs, web pages, and 3D models
Executes shell commands in the harness directory
Reads and mutates Git repository state, including checkout, staging, unstaging, and discarding changes
Exposes a local HTTP configuration and filesystem API
